meta.name: baoyu-post-to-wechat
meta.description: Posts content to WeChat Official Account (微信公众号) via API or Chrome CDP. Supports article posting (文章) with HTML, markdown, or plain text input, and image-text posting (图文) with multiple images. Use when user mentions "发布公众号", "post to wechat", "微信公众号", or "图文/文章".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容自动发布到微信公众号
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把文章或图文发布到微信公众号
copy.tagline_en: Automatically post content to WeChat Official Account
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently need to post articles or image-text to WeChat Official Account

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 可将你提供的文章或图文内容发布到微信公众号草稿箱:能把 HTML、Markdown 或纯文本转成公众号文章,也能组合最多 9 张图片发图文,并负责提取标题、摘要、封面等元数据。
howto.when: 当你提到「发布公众号」「post to wechat」「微信公众号」「图文/文章」等关键词,或直接给出一篇要发的内容时触发。

say.text: 把这篇 Markdown 发布到公众号
say.note: Claude 会先让你选主题并确认标题、摘要等元数据。

say.text: 用图文模式发布,图片在 ./images/ 目录
say.note: 会调用浏览器脚本发布图文,可配标题和内容。

say.text: 把 README.md 作为文章用 API 方式发布
say.note: 需要已有 API 凭证;没有的话它会引导你配置。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can publish your articles or image-text posts to the WeChat Official Account drafts: it converts HTML, Markdown, or plain text into an article, or combines up to 9 images for an image-text post, and extracts title, summary, cover, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like '发布公众号', 'post to wechat', '微信公众号', '图文/文章', or directly provide content to publish.

say_en.text: Publish this Markdown to the WeChat Official Account.
say_en.note: Claude will ask you to pick a theme and confirm metadata like title/summary.

say_en.text: Post an image-text update using the images in ./images/.
say_en.note: It runs the browser script to publish the image-text post.

say_en.text: Publish README.md as an article via API.
say_en.note: Requires API credentials; it will guide you if missing.
